title: Typewriter
description: Types, holds and deletes through a list of words.

a11y.motion: The first word shows as static text with no typing, deleting or cursor. With motion allowed, typing pauses while the pointer is over the text or focus is inside it.
a11y.screenReader: All words are exposed once, comma-separated, in an sr-only span; the typed text and cursor are aria-hidden.
